mostWorthwhile.text: Following the tide onto and off the same beach made the changing shoreline concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: The early sequence felt somewhat prescribed: each step offered only one combination, so there was little to decide.

surprise.text: The explanation that tides travel through ocean basins rather than forming a fixed mound following the Moon changed my understanding.

arbitrary.text: Using the rotating Earth to produce the falling tide felt somewhat abstract, even though the cycle's purpose was clear.

continue.text: I would probably continue for more clear explanations of natural processes, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than the mostly single-option sequence offered here.
